metadata.title: Oracle’s AI Boom Triggers a Thumbs-Up From Citi. Is It Time to Buy?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Oracle’s AI Boom Triggers a Thumbs-Up From Citi. Is It Time to Buy?
Oracle stock is in a weird spot. Sales and earnings growth are exploding, but that hasn’t stopped shares from plummeting in recent months.
